# HKBU Library

> Central hub for Hong Kong Baptist University's library services, resources, and research support across multiple locations and partner institutions.

HKBU Library provides comprehensive access to academic resources, borrowing services, and research support for HKBU students, staff, and external scholars. The library system includes the Main Library, Au Shue Hung Memorial Library, and Special Collections and Archives, with connections to regional resource-sharing networks like HKALL and JULAC.

- HKBU Library
- OneSearch

## Core Services & Access

- [HKBU Library Homepage](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk): Main entry point to HKBU Library with OneSearch, Leganto, and HKALL resources
- [Borrowing & Returning](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/borrowing-returning): Guide to borrowing policies, loan quotas, renewals, and returns
- [Borrowing Details](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/borrowing-returning/borrowing): Detailed borrowing policies and self-check service instructions
- [Research Support](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/research-support): Research support services including citation, plagiarism, and data management

## Library Privileges & Membership

- [Apply for Library Privileges](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges): Library privileges application portal for various user categories
- [Graduate Service Package](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges/graduate-service-package): Graduate membership application and borrowing privilege details
- [SCE Students Library Card](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges/sce-pt-students-library-card): SCE part-time students library card application and privileges
- [BNBU Staff and Students](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges/bnbu-staff-and-students): BNBU staff and students library access policies and services
- [External/Corporate Borrower Card](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges/external-corporate-borrower-card): External and corporate borrower card application and membership fees
- [External Scholars and Visitors](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/apply-for-library-privileges/external-scholars-and-visitors): External scholars and visitors library access and borrower card information

## Resource Sharing & External Access

- [Access Resources Beyond HKBU Library](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/access-resources-beyond-hkbu-library): Guide to HKALL, JULAC cards, and interlibrary loan services
- [Interlibrary Loan & HKALL](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/access-resources-beyond-hkbu-library/interlibrary-loan): HKALL interlibrary loan policies and document delivery procedures
- [JULAC Cards](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/services/access-resources-beyond-hkbu-library/julac-cards): JULAC borrower and reader card eligibility and application information

## News & Announcements

- [CollabTech Commons Updates](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/happenings/news/updates-collabtech-commons): CollabTech Commons opening and facility renovation updates
- [Level 7 Study Area Partial Closure](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/happenings/news/partial-closure-of-l7-202602): Level 7 study area partial closure announcement for repair work (24 February – 27 April 2026)
- [Special Collections and Archives Temporary Closure](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/happenings/news/sca-updates-202603): Special Collections and Archives temporary closure for windows and air-conditioner replacement
- [Level 4 Maintenance Notice](https://library.hkbu.edu.hk/happenings/news/noisy-works-16-29-march-2026): Maintenance notice: Level 4 noise disruption from window replacement (16–29 March 2026)
